title: nodal workspace layout
description: Every path an agent may write, with the schema each JSON file must satisfy. `*` matches one path segment, `**` matches any depth. First match wins, so specific rules come first. The write-guard and validate scripts both read this file. catalog/, .claude/scripts, .claude/schemas and settings are left out on purpose: the validator trusts them, so a human changes them by hand.
